label: Source qualification for a94c5dfc from reading aa15f6c2
note: Aquinas takes willing to permit communication of an already possessed good and applies it to divine will. The case needs more than compatibility: giving the recipient esse must itself be willing that same recipient's actual GOOD_4, with the same giver and recipient. The passage establishes the capacity to communicate a possessed good through willing; whether causing this recipient's esse is thereby willing the good to that recipient is the disputed premise, which the passage leaves open.
